_about: The six style packs as an image model needs them described. Written on 2026-10-02 from the selected concept sheets of each style study and from colours measured in them during the asset-to-sheet pilot (docs/research/2026-10-01-asset-to-sheet-pilot). tools/build_jobs.py reads this file; edit here, then rebuild the jobs. Revised on 2026-10-02 after the pilot batch and a check of every description against the sheets.

lowpoly_tropical.name: Low-poly tropical
lowpoly_tropical.medium: stylised low-poly 3D game model, seen as a clean render: flat faceted planes on foliage, rocks, hair and cloth; buildings and furniture as smooth painted volumes with crisp chamfered edges; matte surfaces, no outlines
lowpoly_tropical.surface: flat painted colour on each face with a soft gradient from light to shade; timber shows a few broad plank lines, stone a few large blocks, foliage is clumps of flat facets in three or four tones; no photographic texture, no noise

palette.architecture: limewash cream and sandstone walls, terracotta roofs, green copper domes
palette.timber: warm mid-brown timber, #613E2B in shade to #C78860 in light
palette.stone: pale warm stone, #817572 in shade to #E7CEB4 in light
palette.foliage: olive to yellow-green leaves (#233019, #586C27, #939B2D, #C5C44A) with pale and pink blossoms
palette.ground: warm cream paving, soft yellow-green lawn, warm grey street
palette.accent: jackfruit yellow for awnings, banners and umbrellas
palette.tram: a cream body with a coral-red stripe
palette.people: green, yellow, white and terracotta clothes

lowpoly_tropical.design_light: soft even daylight from the upper left, as in a product render: every surface readable, gentle shading, no coloured light, no hard cast shadows
lowpoly_tropical.scene_light: warm late-morning tropical sun from the upper left, soft-edged shadows, clear blue sky with a few faceted white clouds
lowpoly_tropical.avoid: smooth realistic foliage, photographic textures, ink outlines, glossy plastic

voxel.name: Voxel
voxel.medium: voxel 3D game model, seen as a clean render: forms built from cubes on one grid, with stepped edges where a curve would be; only the largest roofs (the workshop's sawtooth, the library's vault) are drawn smooth; no outlines
voxel.surface: one flat saturated colour on each cube, with a slight tone difference from cube to cube and soft shading where cubes meet; no painted texture inside a cube face

palette.architecture: a bright yellow workshop, an orange library vault, white and cobalt-glass towers, grey stone base courses
palette.timber: orange-brown timber, #643511 in shade to #F7A544 in light
palette.foliage: saturated greens (#18330B, #448114, #69A715, #A1D026) with white blossom cubes
palette.ground: light grey paving tiles, bright green lawn, dark grey street
palette.tram: a white body with an orange-red stripe
palette.people: blue, orange, green and white clothes

voxel.design_light: bright even daylight from the upper left, soft shading between cubes, no coloured light, no hard cast shadows
voxel.scene_light: bright midday sun, clear blue sky with white cube clouds, short soft shadows
voxel.avoid: smooth or rounded surfaces, diagonal slopes, textures inside cube faces, ink outlines, tiny noisy cubes

anime_cel.name: Cel-shaded anime
anime_cel.medium: cel-shaded anime background art, drawn as a clean toon-shaded 3D game model: flat colour fills, two steps of cool lavender-grey shadow, thin dark ink lines on silhouettes and main edges
anime_cel.surface: flat fills with a hard-edged shadow step and small painted highlights; brick, planks and paving joints drawn as a few thin lines; foliage as layered clusters of small leaf shapes

solarpunk.name: Solarpunk retro-futurism

solarpunk.surface: smooth matte ceramic, timber with a fine straight grain, brushed brass, blue solar panels with a visible cell grid; planting in soft clumps of small leaves; gentle painted shading, not photographic

pixel_art.name: Pixel art
pixel_art.medium: detailed 16-bit-era pixel art game sprite: hard-edged square pixels on one consistent grid, a small fixed palette, dark navy outlines, selective dithering, no anti-aliasing and no blur
pixel_art.surface: flat pixel clusters in two or three tones for each material, with selective dithering between tones; bricks, planks and leaves drawn as small pixel patterns
